a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl (1984), right adrenalectomy (1987), followed by remission until 2014. In 2014, patient presented with palpitations and diaphoresis. In March 2021, patient experienced recurrence of hypertension. Patient had limited access to family history.

In 2021, patient presented with hypertension.
